title.rendered: STREAMS OF JOY DEVOTIONAL- NO DEFEAT

content.rendered: “Then said he unto me, Prophesy unto the wind, prophesy, son of man, and say to the wind, Thus saith the Lord GOD; Come from the four winds, O breath, and breathe upon these slain, that they may live.” (Ezekiel 37: 7)That is the Focal Scripture of Streams of Joy Devotional today.Our Focal Scripture gives an insight into the status of the men that eventually became dry bones. Those men were said to be slain. They probably went into a battle with people who were stronger than they were, and they ended up consumed. What they came to fight against eventually prevailed over them. What they came against overpowered them and they went down. Their opposition prevailed over and above them.Friend, hear me as I hear the Lord: you will not be a victim of what you are currently facing. You will not be reduced by the hands of your adversaries; you will not be cut short by that health challenge that has come against you; you will not be a victim of the conspiracies against you; you will not be a victim of the satanic plots and wicked plans; you will not be consumed by those that have gathered to fight against you.In bible times, battles usually took place in valleys. Any man who went to a valley to fight would have had the capacity to win a battle. So these men went into a battle that they could have actually won, but they ended up slain. They went to do what they had capacity to do, and they were consumed. Every plan of the enemy to defeat you in the same battles you have capacity to win, I command a reversal immediately.Jesus did not redeem you so that you can be a victim of those who do not like you. Jesus did not redeem you so that you can lose the battles you have capacity to win. Jesus did not redeem you so that you can be a victim of the same things you should conquer. Jesus did not redeem you so that you will be overpowered by forces you were raised to subdue.Arise like the giant that you are; break the stronghold of the enemy. Crush the gates of hell around you. Don’t accept to be a victim of the enemy.Ephesians 6: 13 says: “Wherefore take unto you the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to withstand in the evil day, and having done all, to stand.”Declare With Me: I cannot be a victim of the enemy; I will not be overpowered by negativity, in Jesus’ name!Follow on Instagram @jerry_ezeFollow on Twitter @jerrystreams
